0|46cb4b7c88fa5517f64b5bee42939ea3614cddcb|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"sched: dynticks idle load balancing
Fix the process idle load balancing in the presence of dynticks.  cpus for
which ticks are stopped will sleep till the next event wakes it up.
Potentially these sleeps can be for large durations and during which today
there is no periodic idle load balancing being done.
This patch nominates an owner among the idle cpus
balancing on behalf of the other idle cpus.  And once all the cpus are
completely idle
column2: then we can stop this idle load balancing too.  Checks added

column1: in fast path are minimized.  Whenever there are busy cpus in the system
will be an owner(idle cpu) doing the system wide idle load balancing.
Open items:
1. Intelligent owner selection (like an idle core in a busy package).
2. Merge with rcu's nohz_cpu_mask?
